coap-rs answers a skipped Block1 number with 2.31. libcoap capped at 64-byte blocks answers 2.31 SZX 2 on NUM 0; the continuation that starts at NUM 16 later gets 4.08 Missing interim block.
Coaptic NON Q-Block2 recovery against libcoap is an IPv4 UDP process case. CON loss recovery against libcoap, protected and other addressing modes remain unqualified. coap-rs has no Q-Block.
The standalone coap-rs separate-response fixture is exercised over IPv4 UDP only. DTLS, lossy response retransmission, other address families and embedded execution remain unqualified.
The process peers speak DTLS-PSK only. Mutual X.509 between two Coaptic stacks is a plugtest, not a process case, and there is no X.509 process case against libcoap.
These DTLS fixtures have no raw public key.
ETSI DTLS cipher, Finished, alert, and loss schedules are not process cases.

Scoped IPv6 zone identifiers are not a loopback case. MTU cases are absent: a relay that refuses datagrams above 256 bytes drops the 1024-byte blocks, and Coaptic, coap-rs, and libcoap retransmit that size until timeout instead of shrinking.
Two concurrent counter POSTs are covered on the Coaptic and coap-rs servers. Saturation and long soak are not.
Process runs do not measure MCU stack or runtime.
No fuzz or requirements-coverage campaign in this suite.
